rationale: No supported optimization fits this workflow without risking reduced coverage or unsupported assumptions. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast: false to true on the build/test/symbiflow matrix jobs) is contraindicated because this is a test workflow where every matrix outcome provides required diagnostic coverage; the workflow explicitly sets fail-fast: false, and cancelling remaining matrix cells on failure would hide results. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not cleanly apply: jobs run inside ghdl/vunit containers with no npm/pip/go dependency installation to cache, and the only package step (apt install python3-pexpect in the py job) is not a dependency-download pattern supported by the evidence. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit, and the contraindication about valid slow runs exceeding the limit cannot be evaluated. Other patterns (change filtering, test selection, build selection, schedule suppression, environment reuse) would either reduce required test coverage, require CI-service changes outside workflow scope, or depend on infrastructure not present in the repository.
